name: Confront Yeh'kinya
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
My delvings into the Mosh'aru Tablets bear grim news, adventurer.  Hakkar's true form, the god himself, can be born again through the very egg into which you captured him.  Yeh'kinya told you it was to contain his evil, but it is to recreate it!  The troll has led you astray!

Go to Yeh'kinya and demand the egg from him.  Pray that it is not too late to stop Hakkar's return!
narrative.offerRewardText:
So, you have been speaking with that old dwarf Ironboot and uncovered the lost Mosh'aru Tablets, have you?  That meddling prospector...

No matter.  It is too late to save this world.  Hakkar has been reborn, and even now grows in power... deep in the ancient troll kingdom of Zul'Gurub!  He has come!  And he will rule in blood and terror!

Thank you, adventurer.  Your help has sped the return of the Soulflayer!

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 44 to 58, 53,800 XP in all.

quests.name: Screecher Spirits
quests.objectiveText: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
quests.objectiveText: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Ancient Egg
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: The God Hakkar
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Final Tablets
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
